# AlarmList

<!-- Generated by js/scripts/widget-pages.mjs from the trait contract: edit the schema
     or the script, then run it again. -->

Alarm summary table with shelving, suppression and out-of-service states (IND-050 .. IND-053).

!!! danger "Not a safety-related system"
    The alarms shown here may be delayed, lost or stale. It is for visualization, teaching, simulation and supervision; it is not a safety-related system and must not perform a safety function. See the [safety notice](../safety.md).

## Example


## Traits

| Trait | Type | Default | Set by | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | array | `[640,240]` | host | [width, height] in CSS pixels. |
| `value` | array of object | `[]` | derived | Alarms {id, timestamp, source, priority, message, state, shelved_until, suppressed, out_of_service}. Written by the host (Python: raise_alarm(), suppress(), ...); without a host owning the state, the front end applies acknowledgements, shelving and its expiry, and writes the list back (HOST-004, HOST-012). |
| `shelve_durations` | array of number | `[300,900,3600]` | host | Shelving durations offered, in seconds. |
| `max_shelve` | number | `28800` | host | Longest shelving allowed, in seconds (IND-051). |
